ValidationRule.description: #21200 Making the VR applicable for all profiles except Admins
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED( StageName ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),'5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),'6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),'7 - Closed')),
ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Lost'),
$Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin', $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator',
NOT( $Permission.Update_Stage_of_Closed_Opportunities ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Opportunity cannot be moved to a different Stage. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
